subject: MSA + Order Form: proposed language on IP defense, notice timing, and third-party claim handling
body:
--- Message 1 (original) ---
From: Susan Patel <susan.patel@voltix.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@voltix.com
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Voltix redlines to Redwood MSA / order form - defense and IP allocation

Evelyn / Aditya —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Attached are Voltix's redlines to the MSA and order form focused on third-party IP claims. The key asks are:
- Voltix wants Redwood to accept defense and indemnity for claims alleging Redwood model outputs infringe a third party's IP when the output was generated by Redwood models and not caused by customer input.
- If the customer input materially caused the infringing output (including direct copy/paste of third-party content), Voltix requests the customer to indemnify.
- Voltix has a tight notice timeline (7 days) and wants control of counsel for all IP claims.

Can you confirm Redwood's high-level position so we can share with our procurement/legal? We are near final on the procurement side and this is the last open legal item.

Regards,
Susan
Sr. Sourcing Manager, Voltix Systems
Attachments: Voltix-MSA-redlines-20261005.pdf

--- Message 2 (internal reply) ---
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Voltix redlines to Redwood MSA / order form - defense and IP allocation

Team —

Quick summary of Susan's asks (see attached): defense for model-generated infringement unless customer input caused it; 7-day notice; Voltix wants control of counsel.

My thoughts:
- We should push back on 7-day notice; 30 days is more realistic operationally.
- We can accept defense for model outputs in cases where Redwood had no customer-provided content and the output reproduces third-party IP, but only if Voltix provides detailed claim info and cooperates.
- Counsel control: Redwoods needs joint approval of counsel for IP matters to protect model IP and build consistent defenses. We should resist giving unilateral control.
- Cap carveout: carve out willful infringement but avoid an unlimited obligation — suggest we propose damages limited to direct costs of defense + limited settlement cap tied to the order value (e.g., 1x ARR) for these IP claims.

Marissa / Karthik — please draft redline language (short) for defense notice timing, control of counsel, and allocation when customer input is the proximate cause. Aditya — flag any commercial impacts (credits/discounts) if Voltix insists.

Evelyn
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

--- Message 3 (internal legal response) ---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 12:28:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Voltix redlines to Redwood MSA / order form - defense and IP allocation

Evelyn / Karthik —

Draft language below (will send redline doc in an hour):

1) Notice and cooperation: Redwood shall have at least thirty (30) days after receipt of written notice of any claim to investigate and, at its option, assume the defense. Customer shall cooperate and provide information necessary to investigate. Failure to provide prompt notice that materially prejudices Redwood's ability to defend relieves Redwood of indemnity obligations.

2) Control of counsel: Redwood may assume control of the defense of any claim it elects to defend, provided that counsel is reasonably acceptable to Customer; Customer may participate at its own expense. If Redwood does not assume defense within a reasonable time, Customer may assume defense with Redwood's cooperation.

3) Allocation by cause: If a claim arises solely from Customer Content (including direct copying of third-party materials by Customer), Customer shall indemnify Redwood. If a claim arises solely from Redwood model output not attributable to Customer Content, Redwood shall indemnify Customer. For mixed-cause claims, indemnity will be apportioned based on reasonably proximate causation.

4) Financial cap and carveouts: Redwood's indemnity for IP claims shall be limited to direct defense costs and settlement amounts up to the lesser of (i) the fees actually paid under the Order Form in the prior twelve (12) months and (ii) $1,000,000; this cap shall not apply to claims resulting from Redwood's willful misconduct or gross negligence.

Notes: need to confirm if business will accept the $1M cap or prefer a multiplier of ARR. Also confirm whether we want a specific carveout for models trained on public web data — that may be a commercial discussion.

Marissa
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

--- Message 4 (external reply) ---
From: Susan Patel <susan.patel@voltix.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@voltix.com, Rick Gomez <rick@procurevoltix.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Voltix redlines to Redwood MSA / order form - defense and IP allocation

Evelyn —

Thanks for the quick internal work and the draft language. A few points from Voltix legal:
- 30 days is acceptable on notice, but Voltix will want to preserve the right to step in sooner if Redwood delays.
- Voltix cannot agree to Redwood unilateral control of counsel for IP claims; they require the ability to select counsel and control strategy for any claim that will expose Voltix to material liability beyond defense costs.
- The $1M cap is too low for Voltix; they prefer a higher cap tied to order value or insurance-backed limits.

They asked for a call with sales + legal to land on final language. Available today 11:00–13:00 PT.

Susan

--- Message 5 (internal final coordination) ---
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Susan Patel <susan.patel@voltix.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 14:37:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Voltix redlines to Redwood MSA / order form - defense and IP allocation

Thanks, Susan.

Proposed next steps (agreed internally):
1) Marissa / Karthik: prepare a short two-paragraph compromise we can present on the call. Key concessions: 30-day notice; Redwood can assume defense with reasonable customer approval; increase cap ask to be "fees for prior 12 months or $5M, whichever is lower" (business to confirm); keep carveout for willful misconduct.
2) Aditya: prepare commercial options if Voltix insists on higher cap (e.g., premium support credit, limited indemnity surcharge, or proof of insurance requirement).
3) Evelyn: schedule 30-minute call with Voltix for Tue 06 Oct 2026 at 11:30 PT (booked — see DocuSign link) and share proposed compromise before the call.

Susan — can you confirm the 11:30 slot? We'll send a short redline in advance so the legal teams have something to react to on the call.

Best,
Evelyn
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
